idea: AI-assisted pitch and RFP document production for consultancies
pain: Pitch documents consume senior time and are written from scratch each time
v1: A pitch production system plus first three documents
verdict: Recurring shape and warm channel, but the underlying task is being absorbed by general tools.

why.distribution: Warm across finance and design; every professional firm writes pitches.
why.demand: Inferred. Firms grumble about pitch production but rarely budget for it separately.
why.fmf: Writing decision-grade documents fast is her core skill, and she has automated it before.
why.revenue_structure: Setup plus monthly support that renews while the system is used.
why.defensibility: Any firm can build this with an off-the-shelf assistant within a year.
why.leverage: The system reuses; the first documents do not.
why.tailwind: Real AI budget, but pointed at a task that is commoditising fast.
why.ceiling: £2k/mo x 8 clients = £192k, requiring eight retained clients for a service they may soon do themselves.

ceiling_arithmetic: £24k/yr x 8 clients = £192k. Eight retainers is reachable in principle, but retention is the risk: once the system works, the client questions the monthly fee. Realistic: 3 = £72k.
carries: Warm channel across two professions and a recurring structure.
kills: Defensibility at 1. The client's own Copilot licence eats this within a year.
test: Ask four firms what a pitch costs them in senior hours.
test_pass: One quantifies it and asks for a proposal.
test_fail: They say their existing tools already handle it.
